title: Arzoo (1999)
desc: Pregnant Pooja agrees to marry her childhood friend Amar after her fiance, Vijay, dies. But when Vijay unexpectedly returns, Pooja faces a tough choice that changes everything.

title: Gangaajal
desc: IPS Amit Kumar, an honest cop, is posted to a crime-ridden town. He battles ruthless criminals, crooked officers, and shady politicians to restore law and justice.

title: Bol Radha Bol
desc: When Kishan returns to a village to reopen his father's factory, he falls for a local girl. But when he goes back home to share the news, he's shocked to find an impostor living his life.

title: Aakhri Raasta
desc: After 24 years behind bars for a crime he didn't commit, David is free but shocked to find his former accusers now thriving as respected citizens in society.

title: Shaan
desc: When dedicated officer DCP Shiv Kumar falls in the line of duty, his two conmen brothers drop their schemes to relentlessly hunt down every single killer responsible.

title: Kalyug
desc: Kunal and Renuka's happy marriage is shattered when an intimate video surfaces online. Kunal sets out to expose the culprits behind the illegal racket and seek justice.

title: Jaan Se Pyara
desc: Inspector Jai arrests Guman. Later, Jai's mentally challenged brother is abducted in return for a mysterious bag that he knows nothing about.

title: Jawaani Jaaneman
desc: Jazz, a carefree 40-year-old casanova in London, has his world turned upside down when Tia, claiming to be his daughter, enters his life and forces him to change.

title: Roop Ki Rani Choron Ka Raja
desc: Jugran kills a customs officer and a doctor, leaving their kids orphaned. As they grow up facing hardships, the children unite to take revenge on their parents' killer.

title: Kanyadaan
desc: Married as children, Rekha and Amar are separated by fate. Years later, shocking truths emerge as Rekha discovers Amar's new marriage and Kumar's hidden identity.

title: Vijaypath
desc: Justice Saxena sentences a criminal to death. Seeking revenge, Dilawar Singh kills the judge's family and driver. The driver's son, devastated, vows to fight back and settle the score.

title: Cheeni Kum
desc: Buddhadev, a 64-year-old chef, falls for Nina, 34. Their future is shaken when he learns her father is six years younger than him, casting doubt on their relationship.

title: Sarkar 3
desc: Gandhi seeks Sarkar's assistance for a project that will displace people. Sarkar refuses, triggering intense conflicts as power, politics, and betrayal take center stage in this gripping story.

title: Strawberry
desc: A quiet taxi driver named Saravanan learns from student Milovina that a ghost named Anu needs his immediate help to avenge her tragic, untimely death at the hands of ruthless enemies.

title: Krrish
desc: Krrish, gifted with superhuman powers, falls for Priya and travels to Singapore, where shocking truths about his father push him to embrace destiny and fight.
